body.name: multiresolution corrected-energy handle
body.construction: Begin with the exact within-cube identity \(\operatorname{Cov}(A,Y\mid B)-c\operatorname{Var}(A\mid B)=\operatorname{Cov}_B(e,m_0)+(1-e_B)\mathbb E_B[e(\tau-c)]\). For each \(\mathbf k\in\mathcal K_n\), use a coarse signal projection, separate propensity and baseline correction resolutions, and occupancy-weighted fourth-order kernels. Bound all four complete Hoeffding projections by the displayed terms in \(U_n(\mathbf k)\), calibrate the finite family with \(\Lambda_n\), and select the lexicographically first minimizer defining \(r_{\mathrm{test}}(n)\).
